name: Heptabase
description_en:
Heptabase is a visual knowledge base for learning and research. It combines reusable note cards, whiteboards, linked sources, PDF annotation and AI assistance so a topic can be explored spatially rather than only through a folder tree. The current offering separates Pro, Premium and Premium+ by document and AI allowances.

A useful evaluation starts with a real reading question and a small set of sources. Offline access and free collaborator invitations should not be mistaken for a perpetual free owner subscription.
description_zh:
Heptabase 是面向学习和研究的可视化知识库，将可复用笔记卡片、白板、关联来源、PDF 批注与 AI 辅助结合起来，让使用者通过空间组织探索主题，而不仅依赖文件夹。当前 Pro、Premium 和 Premium+ 在文档与 AI 额度上有所区别。

评估时适合从真实阅读问题和少量来源开始。离线访问与免费邀请协作者，不能理解为资料库拥有者可永久免费订阅。

core_features.explanation_en: Organise linked ideas and sources visually.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过可视方式组织关联的想法与来源。

core_features.explanation_en: PDF annotation, clipping and documented Readwise/Zotero integrations support source work.
core_features.explanation_zh: PDF 批注、采集及文档所列 Readwise／Zotero 集成支持来源整理。

core_features.explanation_en: Model access, PDF parsing and monthly AI credits differ by tier.
core_features.explanation_zh: 模型访问、PDF 解析及每月 AI 额度因档位而异。

en: Compare ideas from several readings on a whiteboard.
Reuse source-linked cards while drafting a paper.
zh: 在白板比较多篇阅读资料的想法。
写论文时复用关联来源的卡片。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Desktop and mobile apps with offline access and vendor sync/collaboration.
Deployment.zh: 提供离线访问的桌面和移动应用，以及厂商同步／协作服务。

steps.en: Choose a research question and create cards from a small reading set.
steps.zh: 选择研究问题，从少量阅读资料建立卡片。

steps.en: Arrange cards on a whiteboard and keep source references attached.
steps.zh: 在白板排列卡片，保留来源关联。

steps.en: Check PDF/AI allowances and test offline recovery/export before a large migration.
steps.zh: 大量迁移前确认 PDF／AI 额度并测试离线恢复和导出。

items.en: Desktop/mobile availability and offline access suit individual research across devices. Collaboration is documented, but permission edges, simultaneous edits, conflict recovery and export fidelity were not tested. Before adoption, take a representative board through offline editing, reconnecting and an export/recovery check. A plain text outline may be sufficient for linear writing; Heptabase is most worth investigating when visual relationships and source reuse matter. No self-hosted distribution or open-source licence was verified.
items.zh: 桌面／移动端与离线访问适合跨设备个人研究。文档列有协作，但未测试权限边界、同时编辑、冲突恢复与导出保真度。采用前应让代表性白板经历离线编辑、重新连接及导出／恢复检查。线性写作可能用纯文字提纲就足够；重视可视关系与来源复用时，更值得研究 Heptabase。未核实自行部署发行版或开源许可。

sections.title_en: Build understanding from sources and cards
sections.title_zh: 从来源与卡片建立理解
sections.en: For an illustrative research question, collect a few relevant PDFs, highlight passages and create cards that express one idea each. Arrange the cards on a whiteboard to compare explanations and link back to source material. The official wiki organises learning workflows around readings, visual sense-making and writing. Use arrangement to expose relationships; a visually connected board alone is not evidence that the argument is sound.
sections.zh: 例如研究一个问题时，收集几份相关 PDF，高亮片段，再建立每张表达一个想法的卡片。在白板上排列卡片以比较解释，并关联回来源。官方 wiki 围绕阅读、可视化理解与写作组织学习流程。空间排列可帮助发现关系，但卡片看似相连不证明论证成立。

sections.title_en: Separate source management from AI assistance
sections.title_zh: 区分来源管理与 AI 辅助
sections.en: The site documents block-based editing, bidirectional links, journals, web clipping and Readwise/Zotero integration. It also documents AI help with sources and note organisation. Pro lists Gemini-only agent access and 100 monthly AI credits; Premium adds GPT/Claude/Gemini agents, an AI tutor and 1,800 credits. Check which action spends credits and what source parsing is required before importing a large corpus. No model answer or connector was executed here.
sections.zh: 官网说明了块编辑、双向链接、日志、网页采集，以及 Readwise／Zotero 集成，也说明 AI 可辅助处理来源与组织笔记。Pro 列出仅 Gemini 的代理访问与每月 100 AI 额度；Premium 增加 GPT／Claude／Gemini 代理、AI 导师及 1,800 额度。批量导入前应确认哪些动作消耗额度以及来源解析要求。本次没有执行模型问答或连接器。

sections.title_en: Read the billing selector and upload conditions
sections.title_zh: 核对账期选择与上传条件
sections.en: The retrieved pricing view shows Pro $8.99, Premium $17.99 and Premium+ $53.99 per month beside yearly/monthly selectors. It does not unambiguously expose the selected payment cadence, so these are advertised amounts, not a normalised payable bill. Pro lists unlimited notes, whiteboards, tags, images and collaborator invites; Premium additionally lists unlimited PDF uploads and parsing. Premium+ includes 8,100 AI credits monthly. The homepage advertises a seven-day trial; no ongoing free owner plan was established.
sections.zh: 读取到的定价页在按年／按月选择器旁显示 Pro 每月 8.99、Premium 17.99、Premium+ 53.99。页面没有明确暴露当前付款周期，因此这些是展示金额，不能标准化为实际账单。Pro 列出不限笔记、白板、标签、图片和协作者邀请；Premium 另有不限 PDF 上传与解析。Premium+ 每月含 8,100 AI 额度。首页宣传七天试用；未确认持续免费的拥有者套餐。

sections.title_zh: 本地访问不能解决全部使用条件

research_gaps.en: Selected billing cadence, AI credit rates, migration/export fidelity and live collaboration recovery were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实选中账期、AI 额度消耗率、迁移／导出保真度与真实协作恢复行为。
